summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Sunshine two-sided elder-wellbeing app after major rebuild (RBAC auth, News-as-Home, floating SOS/assistant, medicine intake + low-stock reorder auto-trigger, OCR, concierge with human-in-loop, child analytics, rebrand). All 21 pytest cases pass and the two critical mobile flows (elder phone+PIN and child email+password) work end-to-end.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking on web preview but should migrate for RN 0.75+.
Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a react-native-web internal / expo-router; non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Migrate any local `shadow*` style props to the cross-platform `boxShadow` (or platform-guarded `Platform.select`) to silence the deprecation warning on web.
(Optional cleanup) Replace `pointerEvents` prop usage with `style.pointerEvents` where applicable.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 587 lines and mixes auth, content, health, OCR, concierge, analytics, assistant. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, health.py, concierge.py, ai.py) once feature set stabilises.

OCR endpoint raises 502 on any Gemini exception; that surfaces cleanly (front-end can catch), but consider returning `{medicines: []}` with a 200 when the model simply returns no JSON so a genuinely blank photo doesn't look like a server error.
`/api/assistant/chat` is unauthenticated and writes to DB per call — fine for prototype but should be gated behind `current_user` before shipping to protect Emergent LLM budget.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_sunshine_api.py (rewrote from old reels-era tests to cover the new RBAC + full flow)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (elder login + tabs + SOS + I'm Okay + logout, child login + dashboard + approve task)

seed_data_creation: Fixture reuses seeded elder (phone 9876543210 / PIN 1234, family_code RGSM4D) and child (priya@test.com / secret123). If seeded data is missing, fixture auto-signs-up a fresh elder+child pair with a unique phone/email for the run. Test medicines are prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Elder login: numeric keypad with testIDs key-0..key-9, key-back, elder-submit. Phone must be ≥7 digits and PIN exactly 4 digits before submit enables. Family code shown on Elder Profile in [data-testid="family-code-card"]. Child dashboard cards use testIDs last-active, pending-tasks-card, stock-<id>. Child tasks screen uses approve-<id>, decline-<id>, progress-<id>, done-<id>. OCR web-preview cannot open real camera (expo-image-picker limitation) — backend endpoint verified via base64 blank PNG. Reels sample videos may not autoplay on web preview (poster shown) — DO NOT flag as bug.
